mobbin:b7d28210-31a2-48c6-92fc-604379301.summary: A new merchant lands on Home, inspects empty Alerts and the account menu, advances the setup guide, then reaches a live Home with a few KPIs, “Things to do next,” and a dismissible completed guide.
steps: KPI strip + Things to do + sales guide
Setup guide Done with Dismiss + discovery
steal: Step 0: Accordion setup guide with N/M progress bar and one expanded task that owns primary + secondary CTAs (Add product / Import).
Step 1: Alerts empty copy (“Alerts about your store…”) with mark-all-read affordance visible even when empty.
Step 5: Precise ops card (“2 orders to fulfill”) above longer guides — one countable next action, not a widget wall.
Step 6: Explicit “Dismiss guide” once marked Done, then “All caught up” divider before discovery cards.
avoid: Steps 5–6 stack promotional cards (Shopify Magic, Discover more) under the guide — clashes with “show little, but precisely.”
mobbin:b7d28210-31a2-48c6-92fc-604379301.fit: Replaces today’s weak tile home with a center first-run checklist (rooms/cameras/users) that lives on the dashboard, hands off into Inventory/User management/Scenario manager for each task, and surfaces countable ops (pending grading, recordings to share) before any Reports KPIs.

mobbin:2513bddc-2b15-4e3e-8ba3-39b637ccc.summary: From Home setup guide the merchant opens Add product, inserts a sample product, marks the checklist step done, and watches the right-rail guide advance while staying on the product editor.
steps: Home setup guide 1/11, Add first product expanded
Add product form with persistent setup rail
steal: Steps 1–5: Setup guide stays as a right rail while the user does the real work in the module — not a blocking wizard.
Step 1: “Add a sample product” shortcut to unblock first-run without full data entry.
Step 3: Green “Sample product added” banner with Preview + dismiss.
Step 3–4: Manual “Mark as done” when auto-detect is incomplete.
avoid: Tagged action-items, but screens show setup-checklist progress only — no inbox dismiss/snooze/done on operational tasks.
mobbin:2513bddc-2b15-4e3e-8ba3-39b637ccc.fit: Extends dashboard first-run by keeping the checklist visible while the admin completes the task inside Inventory / Scenario manager / User management; not a substitute for the action-items inbox.
